bot.name: PurpleWave
bot.description: An all-race opponent by Dan Gant with a broad strategy repertoire, precise unit control, and persistent opponent history.

formats.notes: All three upstream races are enabled. Protoss completed a local x64 match and x86 smoke tests; Terran and Zerg have not yet had dedicated SC:R bridge game tests. https://github.com/ShieldBattery/robotics-facility/blob/purplewave-sb-3/docs/releases/purplewave-sb-3.md

mapConstraints: Legacy SC:R unit limits required by the experimental bridge.

learning.notes: Opponent history, placement caches, and logs stay in the isolated profile. Reset read and write to the empty baseline to clear learning; compatible history is preserved across updates.

license.name: MIT
license.notes: Modified ShieldBattery build. Package includes upstream attribution, modification notices, source, and dependency licenses.

localDistribution.evidence: Pinned source and dependency licenses reviewed; original notices, downstream changes, patched source, and build inputs included. https://github.com/ShieldBattery/robotics-facility/blob/purplewave-sb-2/docs/releases/purplewave-sb-2.md

publicCompetition.evidence: Separate from local distribution; author outreach planned by Travis.

limitations: Terran and Zerg are enabled from upstream support; dedicated SC:R bridge game verification is pending. Other game formats remain unverified.
